Remark
[Weak surface trace estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0293 ↗ prop:chow-ii-surface-trace-harnack-positive-curvature 1. ch15:15.8\group Surface Harnack Estimates

For nonnegative scalar curvature, the quadratic trace Harnack estimate remains valid with weak inequality.
Proof

\sketch Apply the positive-curvature estimate to $R+\varepsilon $ in the standard strictly positive barrier argument and let $\varepsilon \downarrow 0$.

□
